stateContract.move: Reuse one master per enemy. Source movement uses transform translation, x mirror and mild shader sine distortion; no enemy animation clips exist. Preserve original source timing; movement preview is not a new frame animation.
stateContract.hit: Source _BlendColor white flash about 0.1s in +0.1s out. Apply to sprite independently; no extra hit PNG required.
stateContract.death: Noise dissolve about 0.3s and projected shadow fade. Keep silhouette intact until dissolve; no death sprite animation claimed.
stateContract.rush: Ghost directional dash and Crow state-machine scale/rush preserve game-key behaviour. Apply position/scale to static master; no pose frames invented.
stateContract.burn: Enemy material flame red tint; do not attach player-negative-status HUD.
stateContract.freeze: Stop movement and shader time, reuse status ring with cold colour; source FreezingBuff effect.
stateContract.slow: Reduce speed/shader time, shared status ring; source SlowBuff effect.
stateContract.boss: Larger visual height, HUD name/health treatment; static portrait does not change actual enemy HP/behaviour.
stateContract.elite: Base texture plus shared elite_halo overlay; renderer placement/timing must be validated in Unity next phase.
